Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelensky has welcomed a major diplomatic breakthrough, saying Europe will now be represented in negotiations with Russia by five countries, alongside the European Union and NATO. Speaking in Berlin, Zelensky said the United States understands the importance of strong European participation in efforts to end the war.
The developments come as diplomatic efforts intensify, with discussions underway for a potential four-party meeting involving Ukraine, Russia, the United States and Europe.
